failure_reason: Category listing pages (/c/*) are blocked by Akamai/PerimeterX bot-protection on all 3 access tiers: (a) direct HTTP/curl returned 403 Access Denied (Akamai edgesuite reference id present) on every /c/ URL tried, even with a warmed cookie jar and Referer header; homepage and /sitemap/*.xml were NOT blocked (200 OK) via curl; (b) Playwright headless returned a client-side bot-check error page (0 products, 'There was an error processing your request'), and Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled returned HTTP 403 Access Denied; (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in Chrome tab) loaded the same URL and stayed on a persistent 'Powered and protected by [Privacy]' bot-check interstitial that did not resolve after two waits (5s, 8s) - a genuine CAPTCHA/bot-check wall, which per policy must not be bypassed. Per the first-block-stops-you rule this was treated as blocked after all 3 tiers failed and no further routes were attempted.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (curl, tier a) checked first - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /'; /c/* category paths are not disallowed for a generic UA (only specific bots like GoogleOther/Baiduspider/Sogou disallow /c/*), so all 3 tiers were permitted to proceed. Tier (a) curl+bs4-style parsing succeeded for https://www.bedbathandbeyond.com/ (200, has __NEXT_DATA__ but no nav data in it - mega-menu is client-fetched) and for /sitemap.xml + /sitemap/ctaxonomy/ctaxonomy.xml (200, 1430 category URLs) - used as the category tree source. Tier (a) 403'd on every /c/... category listing URL tested (e.g. /c/bedding?t=1) - Akamai 'Access Denied'. Escalated to tier (b): Playwright headless got a JS bot-challenge error page; Playwright headed with anti-automation flags got 403. Escalated to tier (c): Claude-in-Chrome (real Chrome session) got stuck on a persistent bot-check interstitial ('Powered and protected by ... Privacy') that never resolved - stopped per the CAPTCHA-bypass prohibition and the first-block-stops-you rule. TREE: built entirely from the official ctaxonomy.xml sitemap (1430 URLs, each a /c/<parent-slug>/<slug>?t=<id> category page) plus the parent-slug relationships it encodes (a slug used as both a leaf and as another set of URLs' parent-slug reveals its own children) - this stands in for the mega-menu + sub-nav union since neither could be rendered. Grouping rows were assigned to any node that itself appears as a parent-slug for further children per rule 25/34 (parent-URL-not-recorded-when-subcategories-exist); leaf categories with no further children in the sitemap were recorded with their sitemap URL. Holiday/seasonal sections (Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day, St. Patrick's Day, Hanukkah, 4th of July) are genuine standing category/subcategory pages in the sitemap (not Collections/promo pages), so qualifying textile leaves under them were included per rule 15. QTY: NOT VERIFIED for any row - every category listing page (the only place qty is displayed) was blocked on all 3 tiers, so every row carries qty=null, link=null-except-the-verified-sitemap-URL, and flag='MANUAL REVIEW: qty not verified - ...'. Per project rule 3, null+MANUAL REVIEW is used instead of any estimated/fabricated number. h1/canonical could not be confirmed for any leaf for the same reason. EXCLUDED (checked, not included) and why: curtain/shower-curtain hardware (rods, rails, rings, hooks, brackets) - hardware not textile; wallpaper - not textile; disposable-tableware, napkin-rings, cookbook-stands - kitchen/dining accessories not textile/storage; bath-pillows, christmas-bathroom-accessories, tub-shower-mats, soap-dishes-dispensers, lotion-pumps, tissue-box-covers, toilet-brushes, vanity-trays/stools, shower-stools, towel-warmers, bathroom-trash-cans, freestanding-toilet-paper-holders, bathroom-tumblers-holders - decorative/fixture bath accessories, primary material/purpose not textile or storage; bathroom-wall-cabinets/bathroom-wall-shelves (under bathroom-fixtures) and linen-towers/over-the-toilet-storage (under bathroom-furniture) - site places these under Furniture/Fixtures categories, so per rule 21 they defer to the Furniture task rather than Storage; entryway-furniture (coat-racks, hall-trees, umbrella-stands) - Furniture; cabinet-hardware, drawer-pulls - hardware; kitchen-trash-cans, bathroom-trash-cans, waste-baskets, recycling-bins, trash-recycling-sorters - waste-disposal receptacles, not organizational storage per the rule set; workbenches, tool-belts - furniture/wearable-accessory, not storage containers; food-vacuum-sealers - an appliance/tool, not a storage container; ironing-boards, clothes-steamers, lint-shavers, pressing-irons, utility-sinks - laundry appliances/fixtures explicitly excluded by rule 11; wall-shelves (under home-decor) - deferred to Wall Decor task; picnic-baskets/picnic-backpacks/picnic-totes - personal-carry items, not home storage (same boundary as excluded handbags); nursing-pillows, pillow-top-mattresses - not home textile (baby feeding aid / mattress); party-tableware-linens>disposable-tableware - not textile. LOW-confidence rows (review queue): Baby Loungers, Rug Pads, Shower Curtain Liners, Napkin Holders, Paper Towel Holders, Toothbrush Holders, Hair Tool Holders - genuinely ambiguous primary material/purpose per the respective rule files' ambiguity-handling sections.
